Read input: mg_10255_combined.v · Open raw
module mg_10255 (clk_in, rst, go, enable, last_clk, divider, clk_out, pos_edge, neg_edge);
parameter Tp = 1; 
  input clk_in; 
  input rst; 
  input enable; 
  input go; 
  input last_clk; 
  input divider; 
  output clk_out; 
  output pos_edge; 
  output neg_edge; 
  reg clk_out; 
  reg pos_edge; 
  reg neg_edge; 
  reg cnt; 
  wire cnt_zero; 
  wire cnt_one; 
  assign cnt_zero = cnt == {1{1'b0}}; 
  assign cnt_one = cnt == {{0{1'b0}}, 1'b1}; 
  always @(posedge clk_in or posedge rst) 
  begin 
  if(rst) 
  cnt <= #Tp {1{1'b1}}; 
  else 
  begin 
  if(!enable || cnt_zero) 
  cnt <= #Tp divider; 
  else 
  cnt <= #Tp cnt - {{0{1'b0}}, 1'b1}; 
  end 
  end 
  always @(posedge clk_in or posedge rst) 
  begin 
  if(rst) 
  clk_out <= #Tp 1'b0; 
  else 
  clk_out <= #Tp (enable && cnt_zero && (!last_clk || clk_out)) ? ~clk_out : clk_out; 
  end 
  always @(posedge clk_in or posedge rst) 
  begin 
  if(rst) 
  begin 
  pos_edge <= #Tp 1'b0; 
  neg_edge <= #Tp 1'b0; 
  end 
  else 
  begin 
  pos_edge <= #Tp (enable && !clk_out && cnt_one) || (!(|divider) && clk_out) || (!(|divider) && go && !enable); 
  neg_edge <= #Tp (enable && clk_out && cnt_one) || (!(|divider) && !clk_out && enable); 
  end 
  end 
 endmodule
